gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.summary:
1. Run setup.exe in the project folder.
2. Launch pyla-rl.bat (or python app/main.py).
3. Set emulator resolution to 1920x1080.
4. Open Brawl Stars in the emulator before START.

overview.title: Overview and START
overview.summary:
1. Pick LDPlayer or MuMu, then Run Checks.
2. Fix required ADB failures before START.
3. Choose Showdown Trio mode and a performance profile.
4. Press START (single-instance) or use Instances tab (multi-instance).

farmPlan.title: Farm Plan
farmPlan.summary:
1. Add brawlers or use Build Queue (Push All).
2. Drag rows to reorder; first brawler is active.
3. Import/Export JSON for backup.
4. Leave empty to use the legacy picker after START.

multiInstance.title: Multi-Instance
multiInstance.summary:
1. Enable Multi-Instance on the Instances tab and follow the quick setup panel.
2. Scan emulators and Quick add unassigned instances (or use Manual Add).
3. Set each instance farm plan from the Farm Plan tab instance selector.
4. Start all ready, then Align windows. Use Overview START only in single-instance mode.

settings.title: Settings and Performance
settings.summary:
1. Accept the free-use license in About.
2. Tune performance profile and debug options.
3. Spacing Aggression purple circle = target hug distance in Debug Screen.
4. After Round controls lobby return vs Play Again on wins.

discord.title: Discord Notifications
discord.summary:
1. Webhook URL + Send Match Summary posts a report after each game.
2. Ping Every X Matches mentions you on match summaries (optional).
3. Heartbeat Every X Minutes is optional; leave at 0 to avoid status spam.
4. Remote slash commands need a bot token (separate from webhooks).

telegram.title: Telegram Control
telegram.summary:
1. Create a bot with @BotFather and paste the token.
2. Send /setup to the bot once to register your chat.
3. Use /status, /pause, /push, and other commands remotely.
4. Keep notification chat IDs private.

api.title: Brawl Stars API
api.summary:
1. Create a developer account at developer.brawlstars.com.
2. Fill player tag and credentials in the API tab.
3. Enables trophy autofill and Push All queue building.
4. Never commit filled API tokens to GitHub.

timers.title: Timers and Recovery
timers.summary:
1. Low IPS recovery restarts scrcpy, game, or emulator.
2. Adjust thresholds if recovery triggers too often.
3. Emulator restart cooldown prevents rapid loops.
4. Check Recovery Log on Overview for recent events.

matchHistory.title: Match History
matchHistory.summary:
1. Review recent matches and session summary.
2. Sort by games or other columns.
3. Reset history from the tab if needed.
4. Discord /stats mirrors live session stats.

remoteControl.title: Remote Commands
remoteControl.summary:
Discord: /pause, /start, /status, /queue, /push, /skip, /remove, /target, /screenshot.
Telegram: /pause, /resume, /status, /queue, /push, /skip, /remove, /target, /screenshot.
Multi-instance: add instance:ld-2 (Discord) or a third argument (Telegram).

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.summary:
1. Run Checks on Overview for ADB/emulator issues.
2. Run python tools/performance_check.py for IPS/GPU.
3. Dual ADB devices: reconnect emulator ADB debugging.
4. Read logs/recovery_events.jsonl for auto-recovery details.
